deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'echo DIAG4_START; psql "$DATABASE_URL" -A -P pager=off -c "SELECT id,job_type,status,attempts,run_after,LEFT(last_error,240) AS err,created_at,updated_at FROM pulse_jobs WHERE job_type LIKE chr(102)||chr(37) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 14" -c "SELECT id,post_id,user_id,status,LEFT(video_url,90) AS video,created_at FROM pulse_reels ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8" -c "SELECT id,recording_status,LEFT(recording_error,220) AS rec_err,updated_at FROM pulse_live_sessions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8" -c "SELECT id,event_type,post_id,created_at,LEFT(payload_json,200) AS payload FROM pulse_live_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 60"; echo DIAG4_END; sleep 600'
